nodes.summary: For every commutative ring $R$ and every $\alpha \in R$, the Weierstrass curve $E_\alpha : y^2 - \alpha x y = x^3 - (\alpha^2 + 5)$ over $R$ has discriminant $\alpha^8 + 5\alpha^6 - 432\alpha^4 - 4320\alpha^2 - 10800$.
nodes.title: Discriminant of the curve $E_\alpha$

nodes.summary: Let $K$ be a number field with ring of integers $\mathcal{O}_K$ such that some prime ideal of $\mathcal{O}_K$ lying over $2$ has ramification index $1$ and inertia degree $1$ over $\mathbb{Z}$. Let $\alpha \in \mathcal{O}_K$ satisfy $\alpha^8 + 5\alpha^6 - 432\alpha^4 - 4320\alpha^2 - 10800 \neq 0$, and let $E_\alpha$ be the curve $y^2 - \alpha x y = x^3 - (\alpha^2 + 5)$ over $K$. If…
nodes.title: Torsion points of $E_\alpha$ with even integral $x$-coordinate have prime-power order

nodes.summary: Let $\alpha$ be an integer with $\alpha^8 + 5\alpha^6 - 432\alpha^4 - 4320\alpha^2 - 10800 \neq 0$, and let $E_\alpha$ be the curve $y^2 - \alpha x y = x^3 - (\alpha^2 + 5)$ over $\mathbb{Q}$. If $P = (x_0, y_0) \in E_\alpha(\mathbb{Q})$ is a point such that $x_0$, written in lowest terms, has even numerator, then $P$ has infinite order.
nodes.title: Points of $E_\alpha(\mathbb{Q})$ with even numerator have infinite order

nodes.summary: For a commutative ring $R$ and $\alpha \in R$, $E_\alpha$ is the Weierstrass curve over $R$ with coefficients $a_1 = -\alpha$, $a_2 = a_3 = a_4 = 0$ and $a_6 = -(\alpha^2 + 5)$, that is, the curve $y^2 - \alpha x y = x^3 - (\alpha^2 + 5)$.
nodes.title: The Weierstrass curve $E_\alpha$ of the generalized fruit equation

nodes.summary: Let $K$ be a number field with ring of integers $\mathcal{O}_K$ such that some prime ideal of $\mathcal{O}_K$ lying over $2$ has ramification index $1$ and inertia degree $1$ over $\mathbb{Z}$. Let $a, b \in \mathcal{O}_K$ be nonzero, let $r \ge 2$ and $d \ge 3$ be odd natural numbers, and let $c = 2^d b - 3^r$. Then the equation $a x^d - y^2 - z^2 + x y z - c = 0$ has no solution $(x, y, z) \in \mathcal{O}_K^3$…
nodes.title: No solutions of the generalized fruit equation with even $x$

nodes.summary: Let $K$ be a number field with ring of integers $\mathcal{O}_K$, and let $T_K$ be the set of prime ideals of $\mathcal{O}_K$ that contain $2$ and have ramification index $1$ and inertia degree $1$ over $\mathbb{Z}$. Then an ideal $P$ of $\mathcal{O}_K$ lies in $T_K$ if and only if $P$ is a prime ideal, $2 \in P$, and $P$ has ramification index $1$ and inertia degree $1$ over $\mathbb{Z}$.
nodes.title: Membership in $T_K$

nodes.summary: Let $K$ be a number field with ring of integers $\mathcal{O}_K$, and let $P \in T_K$, that is, $P$ is a prime ideal of $\mathcal{O}_K$ lying over $2$ with ramification index $1$ and inertia degree $1$ over $\mathbb{Z}$. Then for every $n \ge 1$ the ring $\mathcal{O}_K / P^n$ is isomorphic to $\mathbb{Z} / 2^n \mathbb{Z}$.
nodes.title: Quotients by powers of a prime in $T_K$

nodes.summary: Let $E : y^2 = x^3 + A x + B$ be an elliptic curve over $\mathbb{Q}$ with $A, B \in \mathbb{Z}$. Every point $P = (x, y) \in E(\mathbb{Q})$ of finite order $m \ge 2$ has $x, y \in \mathbb{Z}$.
nodes.title: Nagell–Lutz integrality

nodes.summary: Let $r \in \mathbb{Z}$ and let $N \ge 1$ be an integer such that $s = \gcd(r, N)$ is square-free. Then, as the real number $X \to \infty$, the number of square-free integers $t$ with $1 \le t \le X$ and $t \equiv r \pmod N$ is asymptotically equivalent to
nodes.title: Square-free integers in an arithmetic progression

nodes.summary: As $X \to \infty$ through the natural numbers, the number of square-free integers $t$ with $1 \le t \le X$ and $t \equiv 1 \pmod 8$, divided by the number of square-free integers $t$ with $1 \le t \le X$, tends to $1/6$.
nodes.title: Relative density of square-free integers congruent to $1$ modulo $8$

nodes.summary: Let $t \ne 1$ be a squarefree integer, and let $K$ be a number field of degree $2$ over $\mathbb{Q}$ that contains an element $\alpha$ with $\alpha^2 = t$, so that $K = \mathbb{Q}(\sqrt{t})$. Then the set $T_K$ of prime ideals of the ring of integers $\mathcal{O}_K$ above $2$ with ramification index $1$ and inertia degree $1$ is nonempty if and only if $t \equiv 1 \pmod{8}$.
nodes.title: Unramified degree-one primes above $2$ in quadratic fields

nodes.summary: For a number field $K$ with ring of integers $\mathcal{O}_K$, $T_K$ is the set of prime ideals $P$ of $\mathcal{O}_K$ that contain $2$ and have ramification index $e(P \mid 2) = 1$ and inertia degree $f(P \mid 2) = 1$ over $\mathbb{Z}$.
nodes.title: Unramified primes of degree one above $2$

nodes.summary: Let $K$ be a number field with ring of integers $\mathcal{O}_K$, and let $E$ be a Weierstrass curve with coefficients in $\mathcal{O}_K$ whose base change to $K$ is an elliptic curve. If $P = (x, y) \in E(K)$ is a point of finite order $m \ge 2$ and $m$ is not a prime power, then $x$ and $y$ lie in $\mathcal{O}_K$.
nodes.title: Torsion points of non-prime-power order are integral

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
